assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent watercolor sprite atlas for a quiet winter hiking game.
Reference: preserve the two separate complete animals and their right-facing side-oblique poses, heavy adult body and smaller calf.
Change the winter coat to deep dark brown with warm charcoal and umber shadows, a little muted ochre on upper fur, strong silhouette readable against gray-white snow. This is an illustrated story encounter, not a zoological specimen chart.
CRITICAL: genuinely transparent background, absolutely NO glow, haze, cast shadow, backdrop, paper rectangle, text, landscape, ground or border. Fine fur edges preserve real alpha.
Composition: horizontal 1536x1024 atlas, adult entirely inside left 58 percent, calf entirely inside right 34 percent, a completely transparent vertical gap of at least 7 percent. All four legs and hoof tips fully visible and detached from the other animal; equal hoof baseline around 88 percent canvas height. Calf about half adult height. Both face RIGHT.
Style: fine textured watercolor, delicate ink edges, calm natural expression, original artwork. Keep the layout and body proportions; only darker fur and remove all surrounding haze.
assets.changes: WebP encoding with original alpha. Runtime uses measured separate sprite bounds, mirrors right-facing art for leftward passage.
